line: Seven of Disks: Crowley's title, planetary attribution and place on the Tree, with his account of the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Title and planet, as the chapter gives them (pdf 179, 233).

quotes.quote: The Seven of Disks is called Failure.
made worse by the influence of Saturn in Taurus

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The chapter names the number Seven as Netzach (pdf 233); the Sevens group text does the same (pdf 178).

quotes.quote: The number Seven, Netzach, has its customary enfeebling effect,
These cards are attributed to Netzach.

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: His description of the disks, not a divinatory reading.

quotes.quote: The disks themselves are the leaden disks of Saturn.
